title_as_printed: Table 1. Measured and predicted solubilities and salting coefficients at 25 C and 550 psia*

footnotes_as_printed.*: Used m_o and k_m_i values from Stoessell and Byrne (1982b)

pressure_note: 550 psia (table title). Text: 'Gas pressure was read using a Heise CM 31542 gauge having a dead weight accuracy within 1 psia'; saturation at a single pressure of 550 psia and 25 C. Whether this is total pressure including water vapour or methane partial pressure is not stated.

value.what: measured methane molality (footnote **: Molality); text: molar values converted to molal with pycnometer densities at 25 C, corrected for dissolved-gas volume; each value is the average of at least two measurements

value2.what: methane molality predicted by the authors with Eqn (4), m_s = m_o 10^(-sum k_m_i I_i), using m_o and single-salt k_m_i from Stoessell and Byrne (1982b); NOT a measurement

composition.other_species: K2SO4, MgSO4, Na2CO3, K2CO3 are outside the six-ion set (rows 6, 7, 8, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14 contain at least one of them). Solutions made up gravimetrically from analytical reagent grade chemicals; molality per salt as printed in parentheses in the first column.

extra_unmapped: Salting Coefficient Measured (k_m of the mixture, molal salting coefficient on an ionic-strength basis, log(m_o/m_s) = k_m I; derived_by_authors from the measured molality and m_o of Stoessell and Byrne 1982b)
Salting Coefficient Predicted (k_m from Eqn (2), model; not a measurement)
conversion_needs: The 'parsed <salt> mol/kg' columns are NOT printed as separate columns: they are the molalities printed in parentheses in the first column, split per salt by the extractor so that per_row composition can be read. The printed label column is kept unchanged.
Molality basis of the mixed salts (mol salt per kg water) is as printed; the text says solutions were made up gravimetrically.
notes: One printed table, 14 data rows. Row 5 (four-salt mixture NaCl-KCl-MgCl2-CaCl2) is printed on two lines with the numbers on the first line; written as one CSV row. Subscripts flattened (CaCl2, Na2SO4). Precision of the measurements within 0.0005 molal (average 0.0003). The measured salting coefficients are recorded as derived_by_authors in extra_unmapped. Text: maximum deviation measured vs predicted is 0.0028 molal for NaCl-MgCl2 (row 3: 0.0264 vs 0.0236), consistent with the table.
